summary: Silver Point Specialty Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting that its adviser, Silver Point Specialty Credit Fund Management, notified U.S. Bancorp Fund Services of termination of the Master Servicing Agreement effective December 31, 2026. Concurrently, on October 12, 2026, the Fund and adviser entered a new Sub-Administrative Services Agreement with HS Financial Technologies Corporation, effective January 1, 2027, covering substantially similar services with a monthly fee, one-year initial term and automatic one-year renewals. Termination requires 60 days' Fund notice or 180 days' administrator notice. This is a routine service-provider change, not a special situation.
